master.definition_en: Strabismus is the intermittent or constant misalignment of an eye so that its line of vision is not pointed at the same object as the other eye. Strabismus is caused by an imbalance in the extraocular muscles which control the positioning of the eyes. Strabismus is normal in newborns but should resolve by the time the baby is 6 months old. In older children with strabismus, the brain may learn to ignore the input from one eye, and this may lead to amblyopia, a potentially permanent decrease in vision in that eye if not corrected.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 青光眼不直接危及生命，却是全球不可逆失明的头号致盲原因！开角型青光眼被称为“视力小偷”，早期无痛无感悄然蚕食周边视野；而中国高发的**急性闭角型青光眼**可在数小时至1–2天内眼压飙升至50–80 mmHg以上，造成视神经永久性压迫失明（常伴剧烈头痛恶心呕吐，极易被误诊为脑梗或急性胃肠炎延误抢救！）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 已丢失的视神经纤维与视野目前无法再生恢复，但只要早发现并通过降眼压滴眼液（前列腺素类、β阻滞剂、ROCK抑制剂）、激光周边虹膜切除术或小梁切除/微创青光眼手术将眼压控制在靶眼压以下，绝大多数患者可终身保住现有有用视力。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD 2021未将青光眼列为直接死因，其核心公共卫生危害为不可逆致盲
annual_deaths_global.source: IHME GBD 2021 / WHO Blindness and Vision Impairment

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球40–80岁人群青光眼患者约7,600万–8,000万例（GBD 2021持续攀升），致盲人数超700万
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国青光眼患者人数估计超2,100万例（居全球首位），且闭角型青光眼在亚洲/中国占比显著高于欧美

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性闭角型青光眼暴盲24小时抢救：1) 一旦在暗光环境（如看电影、关灯看手机）或情绪激动后突发**单侧眼痛、视力急降、看灯光有彩虹圈（虹视）伴剧烈同侧偏头痛、恶心呕吐**，切勿仅去消化科或神经科止吐止痛，立即急诊眼科测眼压！2) 黄金抢救窗仅数小时至24小时，立即静脉滴注20%甘露醇脱水降眼压、口服乙酰唑胺及滴用毛果芸香碱缩瞳，眼压稳定后行激光周边虹膜切除术。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 激光与手术干预：浅前房高危人群可预防性行激光周边虹膜切开术（LPI）防急性闭角发作；药物控压不佳者行选择性激光小梁成形术（SLT）、小梁切除术或微创青光眼手术（MIGS）
日常避坑：切忌长期关灯侧躺看手机，闭角型青光眼未行激光预防前严禁盲目使用阿托品等散瞳药或含抗胆碱成分的复方感冒药；避免一次性牛饮大量水及长期倒立憋气
40岁以上及有青光眼家族史者每年体检务必加查“眼压+眼底照相/OCT视神经纤维层厚度”

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向小梁网通路的ROCK抑制剂（奈他舒地尔）及一氧化氮供体前列腺素（Latanoprostene bunod）提供更强效降眼压；2) 眼内缓释植入剂（如比马前列素前房植入物）解决老年患者每天忘记滴眼药水的痛点；3) 神经保护剂与RGC视网膜神经节细胞再生/线粒体保护（如烟酰胺临床试验）正探索直接保护视神经。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 开角型青光眼早期无痛无感，我国超过半数患者确诊时已达中晚期管状视野；2) 滴眼液需终身每日按时使用，患者依从性差且防腐剂易致重度干眼眼表损伤；3) 尚无获批的“视神经再生修复”疗法能够挽回已经丧失的视野。

master.definition_en: A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.

aliases_zh: 非胰岛素依赖型糖尿病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 胰岛素抵抗伴进行性胰岛β细胞功能减退引起长期慢性高血糖，数年至数十年间持续损伤微血管和大血管，是心脑血管病（心肌梗死、脑卒中）、终末期肾病、失明及非创伤性截肢的核心致死致残动因；老年重度失代偿亦可发生致死率极高的高渗性高血糖状态（HHS）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 绝大多数患者通过生活方式干预联合二甲双胍、SGLT2抑制剂、GLP-1受体激动剂（含双靶点激动剂）及胰岛素等多机制靶向治疗，不仅能稳定控制HbA1c，更可显著降低心肾终点死亡率；少数超重肥胖早期患者通过强效代谢手术或减重达标可实现临床缓解。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: IDF第11版报告2024年全球20-79岁全类型糖尿病相关年死亡超340万例，其中90%以上为2型糖尿病患者；因IDF摘要按全类型糖尿病口径合并报告，故未单列纯T2DM数值

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: IDF第11版估算中国20-79岁全类型糖尿病相关年死亡约76万例（居全球第一），其中绝大部分归因于2型糖尿病及其心肾并发症

epidemiology.prevalence_global: IDF第11版（2025）报告全球20-79岁成人糖尿病患者约5.89亿（其中>90%为2型糖尿病），预计至2050年将升至8.53亿。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: IDF第11版估算中国成人糖尿病患者约1.48亿，患病人数居全球首位；成人标化患病率持续攀升且农村及年轻人群增长显著。

research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中国近半数患者尚未确诊或未达标（知晓率、治疗率及HbA1c<7%综合达标率仍待提升）；2) 基层糖尿病足、视网膜病变及早期CKD（UACR）筛查率严重偏低；3) 多重并发症高龄患者的去强化安全用药体系需加强。

master.definition_en: A rare congenital limb malformation syndrome characterized by facial dysmorphism (high forehead, depressed nasal bridge, long philtrum, flat malar region, high arched palate), short stature and deformities of the hands and feet (small hands/feet, flexion contractures of the first three metacarpophalangeal joints, extension contractures of the thumbs at the interphalangeal joints, clawed toes, mild pes cavus). Additional features include neonatal hypotonia, thin and shiny skin of the hands/feet, ridged nails, dry and coarse hair, mild weakness of the orbicularis oculi muscles and occasional ventricular extrasystoles. Intellectual disability may be present. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1970.

master.definition_en: Early infantile epileptic encephalopathy 4 (EIEE4) is a form of early infantile epileptic encephalopathy, which refers to a group of neurological conditions characterized by severe seizures beginning in infancy. EIEE4, specifically, is often associated with partial complex or tonic-clonic seizures, although other seizure types have been reported. Other signs and symptoms mayinclude intellectual disability, reduced muscle tone (hypotonia), hypsarrhythmia (an irregular pattern seen on EEG), dyskinesia (involuntary movement of the body), and spastic di- or quadriplegia. EIEE4 is caused by changes (mutations) in the STXBP1 gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person. For example, certain medications are often prescribed to help control seizures, although they are not always effective in all people with the condition.
synonyms_en: early infantile epileptic encephalopathy caused by mutation in STXBP1

master.name_en: intellectual disability-severe speech delay-mild dysmorphism syndrome
master.definition_en: An autosomal dominant form of syndromic intellectual disability caused by mutation in the FOXP1 gene. It is characterized by global developmental delay with moderate to severe speech delay that affects expressive speech. Most patients have difficulty articulating words. Common signs and symptoms include broad forehead, downslanting palpebral fissures, short nose with broad tip, head appearing too large for the body, frontal hair upsweep, and bulging digit pads and delayed gross motor skills. Some patients have autistic features and/or behavioral problems. Congenital malformations may be associated. All reported cases have occurred de novo (without any cases in the family).

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Complete atrioventricular canal (CAVC), also referred to as complete atrioventricular septal defect, is characterized by an ostium primum atrial septal defect, a common atrioventricular valve and a variable deficiency of the ventricular septum inflow.
synonyms_en: Complete atrioventricular septal defect with atrial and ventricular components
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

curated.name_zh: 遗传性球形红细胞增多症
curated.category: 遗传性红细胞膜缺陷溶血病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 编码红细胞膜骨架蛋白的基因（如ANK1、SLC4A1、SPTA1、SPTB、EPB42）突变，使原本柔韧的双凹圆盘状红细胞变成僵硬脆弱的“小圆球”; 2) 这些球形红细胞在穿过脾脏微小筛孔时极易被卡住撕碎，造成终生慢性溶血性贫血、皮肤眼白发黄（黄疸）、脾肿大及早发胆结石; 3) 平时多呈慢性稳定，但一旦感染细小病毒B19可突发“再生障碍危象”（骨髓暂时停产红细胞，血红蛋白数天内骤降危及生命）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 轻症患者仅需补充叶酸及定期随访即可正常生活；中重度贫血或频繁输血依赖者，待儿童满5–6岁后行腹腔镜脾切除术（或部分脾切除术）可几乎完全终止红细胞在脾脏的破坏，使血红蛋白恢复正常并彻底告别输血。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列HS死因；规范随访与脾切除后患者总体预期寿命接近常人，极少数死于未接种疫苗的脾切除后爆发性感染或未及时输血的再障危象

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国死亡登记；系统评价模型估算中国HS临床诊断患病率约1.2–1.5/10万，但因轻症常被误诊为普通贫血或Gilbert综合征，实际携带者更多
annual_deaths_china.source: PubMed 中国HS流行病学与基因队列研究

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 北欧及北美高发人群约 1 / 2,000 – 1 / 5,000（Orphanet ORPHA:822）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国文献模型估算患病率约 1.2–1.5 / 100,000，其中ANK1与SPTB突变占比最高且临床表型相对较重，SLC4A1突变多呈常染色体显性轻型

standard_drugs.drug_class: B族维生素（骨髓代偿性高速造血的必需原料，防止巨幼细胞危象）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 中重度慢性溶血患者终生或长期日常补充
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内公立医院参考价约3–10元/瓶（5mg×100片），年药费约20–50元

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系级联筛查与基因检测：约75%为常染色体显性遗传，建议父母、子女及同胞行血常规+外周血涂片（球形红细胞比例）及NGS基因panel（ANK1/SLC4A1/SPTA1/SPTB/EPB42）明确遗传模式与病情分层
腹腔镜全脾或部分脾切除术：中重度患者（如频繁输血、生长发育迟缓）建议推迟至5–6岁后手术，术前至少2周必须接种肺炎球菌、脑膜炎球菌及Hib疫苗防术后爆发性脓毒症（OPSI）
定期腹部超声监测胆囊结石（长期高胆红素极易形成色素性胆石，必要时脾切同期行胆囊切除）
发热病毒感染后若突然出现极度苍白乏力（警惕细小病毒B19诱发的再生障碍危象），应立即查血常规与网织红细胞并急诊输血
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 轻症及术后稳定患者仅需补充叶酸及年度超声随访，年费用约500–1,500元人民币；若行腹腔镜脾切除手术（含术前疫苗），单次住院费用约2万–4万元人民币

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年中国多中心儿童及成人HS基因队列研究明确了精确的基因型-表型图谱（ANK1与SPTB截短突变较SLC4A1/SPTA1溶血更重、更早需切脾），使二代测序（NGS）联合伊红-5'-马来酰亚胺（EMA）流式结合试验成为快速确诊金标准；此外，部分脾切除术与脾动脉栓塞术在保留免疫功能的同时改善贫血正积累更多长期随访证据。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 轻中型患者极易被漏诊或误诊为“缺铁性贫血”而盲目长期补铁导致铁过载; 2) 尚无修复红细胞膜骨架蛋白的靶向药物或基因疗法; 3) 脾切除术后远期血栓风险与感染防控需终生精细化管理。

master.definition_en: A primarily a lung disorder characterized by onset of respiratory insufficiency due to pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP) in the first months of life. Affected individuals may have normal respiratory function at birth. Development of the disorder appears to be influenced or triggered by viral infection, manifest as progressive respiratory insufficiency, confluent consolidations on lung imaging, and diffuse collection of periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive material in pulmonary alveoli associated with small and nonfoamy alveolar macrophages. Patients also have hypogammaglobulinemia, leukocytosis, and splenomegaly. Many patients die of respiratory failure in infancy or early childhood; hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is curative. The pathogenesis may be related to abnormal function of alveolar macrophages, resulting in decreased catabolism of surfactant. The disorder results from a gain-of-function effect that particularly affects B cells and monocytes.
synonyms_en: immunodeficiency (due to OAS1 gain-of-function variant) with pulmonary alveolar proteinosis and hypogammaglobulinemia
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: A rare pulmonary condition characterized by non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema occurring in otherwise healthy individuals within days of an ascent above 2500-3000 m. Early symptoms include exertional dyspnea, non-productive cough, chest tightness, and reduced exercise performance, followed by dyspnea at rest and possibly orthopnea, as well as gurgling in the chest and pink frothy sputum in advanced cases. Clinical signs are cyanosis, tachypnea, tachycardia, crackles or wheezing, and elevated body temperature (generally not exceeding 38.5°C). Signs of concomitant high-altitude cerebral edema may also be observed. Chest x-rays typically show patchy opacities predominantly in the right middle lobe.

master.definition_en: A rare inflammatory optic neuropathy characterized by isolated episodes (either single or recurrent) of optic neuritis not associated with other neurological or systemic disease. Patients typically present with subacute unilateral loss of vision progressing over several days to two weeks, periocular pain and pain on eye movement (which may precede the onset of visual symptoms), light flashes on eye movement, abnormal color vision, reduced contrast sensitivity, and relative afferent pupillary defect. The optic disk appears swollen in many patients, and uveitis may be associated and can be present for years before the onset of optic neuritis.

master.definition_en: A rare, congenital, fetal lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) anomaly occurring in males and characterized by a posteriorly directed semilunar fold arising from the floor of the anterior urethra and causing urethral obstruction during micturition. The valves may be located anywhere distal to the membranous urethra. Clinical presentation is highly variable, depending on age and degree of urinary obstruction, and includes urinary incontinence, urinary retention, weak urinary stream, post-micturitional dribbling, bulging on the ventral penis, urinary tract infection, and urosepsis.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。
